message.content:
This is a minimalist footer section with a dark navy blue background, featuring a clean, professional layout divided into two main columns. The design uses a sophisticated color palette and maintains consistent spacing throughout.

## Overall Layout & Structure
- **Background Color**: #2C3E50 (dark navy blue)
- **Container Width**: 1100px (centered, max-width)
- **Layout**: Two-column grid layout with 1fr 1fr distribution
- **Padding**: 80px 0 (vertical) and 0 (horizontal) on the main container
- **Border**: Thin white border-top and border-bottom (#FFFFFF) with 1px width

## Header Section
- **Title**: "Lemon & Ardent"
- **Typography**: 
  - Font family: 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif
  - Font size: 28px
  - Font weight: 300 (light)
  - Color: #FFFFFF (white)
  - Letter spacing: 0.5px
  - Margin-bottom: 60px

## Left Column - Contact Information
- **Typography**: 
  - Font family: 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif
  - Font size: 16px
  - Font weight: 400 (regular)
  - Color: #BDC3C7 (light gray)
- **Spacing**: 
  - Margin-bottom: 30px between each contact item
- **Content**:
  - Phone: "123-456-7890"
  - Email: "info@mysite.com"
  - Address: 
    - "500 Terry Francine St."
    - "San Francisco, CA 94158"

## Social Media Icons
- **Container**: Inline-flex with gap between icons
- **Icon Style**:
  - Background: #FFFFFF (white)
  - Border-radius: 50% (circular)
  - Width: 40px
  - Height: 40px
  - Display: flex
  - Align-items: center
  - Justify-content: center
  - Margin-right: 15px
- **Icons** (from left to right):
  - Instagram (camera icon)
  - Facebook (f icon)
  - Twitter/X (bird icon)
  - TikTok (musical note icon)
- **Icon Color**: #2C3E50 (navy blue, matching background)

## Right Column - Links
- **Typography**: 
  - Font family: 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif
  - Font size: 16px
  - Font weight: 400 (regular)
  - Color: #BDC3C7 (light gray)
- **Link Style**:
  - Text-decoration: none
  - Transition: color 0.3s ease
- **Hover State**:
  - Color: #FFFFFF (white)
- **Content** (vertical list):
  - "Privacy Policy"
  - "Accessibility Statement"
  - "Shipping Policy"
  - "Terms & Conditions"
  - "Refund Policy"
- **Spacing**: 
  - Margin-bottom: 15px between each link

## Copyright Section
- **Typography**: 
  - Font family: 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif
  - Font size: 14px
  - Font weight: 300 (light)
  - Color: #95A5A6 (medium gray)
- **Content**: 
  - "© 2035 by Lemon & Ardent."
  - "Powered and secured by Wix"
- **Spacing**: 
  - Margin-top: 40px

## Bottom Right Corner - Commitment Card
- **Position**: Absolute, bottom right corner
- **Background**: #F8F9FA (very light gray)
- **Border**: 1px solid #E9ECEF (light border)
- **Border-radius**: 8px
- **Padding**: 15px
- **Width**: 180px
- **Box-shadow**: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)
- **Content**:
  - Title: "Our Commitment" (bold, 14px)
  - Description: Small text about company values (12px, #6C757D)

## Visual Hierarchy
1. Brand name (largest, lightest weight)
2. Contact information (medium size, regular weight)
3. Social icons (visual elements)
4. Policy links (regular size, regular weight)
5. Copyright text (smallest, lightest weight)

## Design Tokens
- **Primary Color**: #2C3E50 (navy blue)
- **Secondary Color**: #FFFFFF (white)
- **Text Color**: #BDC3C7 (light gray for main text)
- **Accent Color**: #FFFFFF (white for hover states)
- **Border Color**: #FFFFFF (white)
- **Shadow**: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) for the commitment card
- **Border Radius**: 50% for social icons, 8px for commitment card
- **Spacing Unit**: 15px (base unit for margins and padding)
- **Font Sizes**: 28px, 16px, 14px (hierarchy)
- **Font Weights**: 300 (light), 400 (regular)

The design maintains excellent readability with high contrast between text and background, uses consistent spacing throughout, and creates a professional, trustworthy appearance suitable for a business footer. The social media icons add visual interest without overwhelming the clean layout, and the commitment card in the corner provides additional context about the company's values.
